requirement.value: Cook (Gourmet), Archivist (Loremaster) or Engineer (Tinkerer) mastery (the Merchant route is cut)

system.description: Potions and delicacies you create, as well as spells you cast, can now cause creatures to recover Hit Points and Mind Points beyond their maximum HP and MP scores, up to 150% of the respective scores. At the end of each scene, if the current Hit Points and/or Mind Points of a creature are still above the maximum scores, they become equal to the maximum score.
